declaration.question: When strong premarket opening momentum is plentiful, does concentrating capital on the strongest opportunities or the strongest sessions produce meaningfully higher compound growth than E-Base, within a finite risk envelope?
declaration.primary_objective: maximize compound growth (CAGR) at COST_10BP subject to the risk envelope and the statistical minimum
declaration.not_computed_in_m0: no ranking, capacity, breadth, exit or exposure return of any kind

base_frozen.rule: E-MAX never overwrites, edits or re-labels a Base artifact; every E-MAX artifact lives under docs/backtest/strategy_e_max/ and app.strategy_e_max

base_reference_values.role: comparator values already published by E-R3; not recomputed in M0

feature_pool.source: the four frozen H5 inputs, sealed at 09:25 (strategy_e1_forward.seal.H5_INPUTS)

gap_alone_ranking.reason: prior Research evidence (E1_PREMARKET_OPEN_PREVALIDATION.md, 'premarket_gap - not monotone, and the big gaps reverse'; section 490 'The premarket gap on its own carries no information and inverts where it is largest') argues against ranking by gap; decided from that existing document before any E-MAX result

structural_facts_used.source: E-R3 runtime daily_returns.csv, structural columns eligible and h5_candidates only; no return column read
structural_facts_used.coverage_regime: the development minute tape carries only the 30 MINUTE_UNIVERSE_V1 symbols before 2026-04-20 (mean universe 28.6 rows/session) and the broad collection from 2026-04-20 (mean 580.6)
structural_facts_used.implication: absolute H5 count measures data coverage, not market conditions, in this dataset; ranking, capacity and breadth can differ from Base on about 101 sessions, almost all in the last 104 sessions (one coverage regime, chronological block 4)

research_budget.rule: budgets count every declared variant of a stage as listed below; a failed stage does not earn a new variant; any additional hypothesis is a new version and a new research cycle

stages.E-MAX-M2: capacity study, using the M1 ordering
stages.E-MAX-M3: breadth / session-strength study, using the M1 ordering and the M2 capacity
stages.E-MAX-M4: aggressive exit study, only if still justified (see exit.run_condition)
stages.FORWARD: only if the MAX V1 candidate survives M6
stages.per_stage_procedure: a stage protocol (implementation, data binding, outputs) is frozen and committed before the stage runs; the stage runs once; its result is frozen; the next stage takes the frozen winner or the carried comparator
stages.skip_rule: a stage whose outcome is NO_USEFUL_ENHANCEMENT carries its comparator forward; it does not end E-MAX by itself

ranking.scope: orders the session's sealed H5 candidates; selection takes the first `capacity` of that order; replacement NONE; everything else is Trading V1.1

hypotheses.name: equal-rank composite
hypotheses.rule: for each of premarket_rvol, return_0900_0925 and position_in_premarket_range, rank the session's H5 candidates descending (1 = largest, ties receive the average rank); score = sum of the three ranks; order by score ascending

ranking.information: all inputs are sealed 09:25 values; every H5 candidate has them finite (the H5 mask requires it)

capacity.sizing: EQUAL_WEIGHT_EXECUTABLE_V1 semantics (1/n over executable positions, n <= max_selected); normalized daily gross 1.0
capacity.risk_v1_conflict: Common Risk V1 caps max_open_positions and max_new_symbols_per_day at 3; C2 is a development research variant only and cannot be traded without a new, separately approved risk version

breadth.principle: breadth never turns a trade on or off; it only scales exposure of an otherwise unchanged session
breadth.measure: h5_rate = H5 candidate count / 09:25 PIT universe rows, both known at the seal
breadth.coverage_guard: h5_rate is defined only when the universe has at least 100 rows, so a single candidate cannot exceed 1%; below that the session is treated as B1

hypotheses.rule: exposure multiplier 1.5 when h5_rate >= 0.030741 and universe rows >= 100, else 1.0

breadth.threshold_source: 75th percentile (numpy quantile, method 'higher') of h5_rate over the 104 development sessions with at least 100 universe rows; structural only, no return used; 26 sessions meet it (each with >= 16 candidates)
breadth.exposure_semantics: session net return x multiplier; costs scale with notional; research-only (see exposure.risk_v1_conflict)

exit.run_condition: M4 runs only if the configuration entering it (M1-M3 winners or carried comparators) passes the eligibility conditions of the selection rule; otherwise M4 is skipped and recorded as SKIPPED_NOT_JUSTIFIED
exit.research_prior: E1-H5 development mean lift over the baseline (E1_PREMARKET_OPEN_PREVALIDATION.md table at line 229): open->1m +6.49 bp, open->5m +16.54 bp, open->15m +5.70 bp ("continuation peaks at five minutes and is gone by fifteen"); an unconditional longer hold is not supported, so only one conditional variant is allowed and its prior is weak

hypotheses.name: momentum continuation
hypotheses.rule: at the close of the exact 09:34 bar: if close(09:34) > open(09:30) hold and exit at the exact 09:44 ET close; otherwise exit at close(09:34). An extended position without a valid exact 09:44 bar is UNRESOLVED_EXIT / INVALID_FOR_STANDARD_PNL; no fallback
hypotheses.information: the hold decision uses only the 09:30 open and the 09:34 close, both known at 09:35:00 ET
hypotheses.cost: one round trip, COST_10BP primary, unchanged

exposure.semantics: session net return x multiplier applied to the frozen M1-M4 configuration; costs scale with notional; no financing cost modelled (reported as a limitation)
exposure.risk_v1_conflict: Common Risk V1 base capacity is 0.80 of equity and it has no leverage; multipliers above 1.0 are development research only and not tradable without a new, separately approved risk version
exposure.precondition: M5 runs only if at least one of M1-M4 produced a winner; E-MAX is not a leveraged copy of E-Base

risk_envelope.rule: a candidate with COST_10BP maximum drawdown below -0.35 (i.e. deeper than 35%) fails; -0.35 itself is eligible
risk_envelope.role: development research envelope, not a live account recommendation
diagnostics: recovery duration (sessions from drawdown start to new high, or open)
risk_envelope.symbol_exclusion: forbidden (ABSI included); no symbol-removed figure is a primary output

selection_rule.metrics: E-D6 metrics unchanged (app.backtest.strategy_e_d6.metrics) over the 480-session E-R2 timeline, no-trade sessions at 0, COST_10BP
eligibility: integrity PASS (E-R2 prechecks and deterministic repeat)
COST_10BP mean session return > 0 and profit factor > 1.0
COST_10BP top1 symbol share of total net contribution <= 0.7338 (E-Base), so an improvement cannot come from more concentration
improvement_vs_stage_comparator: paired IID session bootstrap of (candidate - comparator) COST_10BP session returns, 10,000 replicates, seed 20260921: mean difference > 0 and P(difference <= 0) <= 0.10
selection_rule.winner: among candidates meeting every condition, the highest COST_10BP CAGR = (1 + cumulative)^(252/480) - 1; ties by higher session mean, then by declared order
selection_rule.no_winner: NO_USEFUL_ENHANCEMENT; the comparator is carried forward
statistical_minimum_reported: bootstrap 95% CI of the session mean
selection_rule.chronology_note: because ranking, capacity and breadth can only differ from Base on ~101 sessions concentrated in block 4, a block-level test of the difference is reported but is not a selection condition

development_reuse_guard.dataset: the E-R2 frozen development binding (tape d12ff28a98cf9cc6..., USB-HIST-V1, 480 sessions 2024-10-16..2026-09-16); forward sessions >= 2026-09-17 excluded
development_reuse_guard.rule: preregister -> execute once -> freeze; no parameter change or re-run within a stage after its result

evidence_labels.E-MAX DEVELOPMENT: new exploratory evidence on reused development data; never described as OOS

stop_conditions.A: no aggressive enhancement: M1 to M4 all end NO_USEFUL_ENHANCEMENT (or skipped) -> E-MAX V1 stops; M5 does not run
stop_conditions.B: risk outgrows return: at any stage winner, |MDD| / |MDD of E-Base| exceeds CAGR / CAGR of E-Base (both COST_10BP) -> flagged; if it holds at M6, E-MAX V1 stops
stop_conditions.C: more concentration: covered by the top1 eligibility guard; a stage whose only improving candidates fail that guard -> NO_USEFUL_ENHANCEMENT and recorded as Stop C evidence
stop_conditions.D: risk ceiling: every candidate of two consecutive executed stages below -0.35 MDD -> E-MAX V1 stops
stop_conditions.E: data mining: any proposal outside this budget, or without prior support, requires a new version; it cannot be appended to E-MAX V1

prohibitions: changing H5, its thresholds or the Trading V1.1 universe
new ranking features or weight search
horizon scans or exits other than X1 and X2
lowering the primary cost below 10 bp
excluding ABSI or any symbol, or any period
any E-MAX performance calculation in M0
